abstract: This study systematically evaluates forecasting performance of 11 Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) and 2 Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) models during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area. Results show that no single model dominates: parsimonious models perform well in stable periods and at short horizons, while richer DSGE specifications with financial frictions, flexible inflation targeting, or labor market dynamics improve forecasts during recessions. BVARs excel in interest rate forecasting, especially in expansions. Crisis‐specific extensions, such as COVID‐related shocks, yield temporary gains. Forecast accuracy depends on the economic state, variable, horizon, and evaluation metric, underscoring the need for a diversified, context‐dependent modeling toolkit.
abstract_zh: 本研究系统评估了11种动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型与2种贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型在美国和欧元区经济衰退与扩张期间的预测表现。结果表明，不存在单一主导模型：简约型模型在稳定时期及短期预测中表现良好，而包含金融摩擦、灵活通胀目标或劳动力市场动态的复杂DSGE模型则能改善衰退期的预测精度。BVAR模型在利率预测方面表现突出，尤其在扩张期。针对特定危机的扩展（如新冠疫情相关冲击）可带来短期预测增益。预测准确性取决于经济状态、变量类型、预测期限及评估指标，这凸显了构建多元化、情境依赖型建模工具集的必要性。
title: Macroeconomic forecasting during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area
title_zh: 美国与欧元区经济衰退与扩张时期的宏观经济预测

abstract: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of salary history bans, which prohibit firms from inquiring about applicants' prior wages. When salary histories are banned, firms cannot tailor their wage offers to the applicants' prior wages and thus offer the same wage to each group of workers. While this benefits relatively low earners, the wage gap between groups may widen. Salary history bans also affect (young) workers' behavior in initial negotiations, where they act less aggressively and demand lower wages. Finally, salary history bans are shown to reduce worker turnover, but to increase the hiring of younger workers.
abstract_zh: 本文对薪资历史禁令进行了理论分析，该禁令禁止企业询问求职者过往薪资。当薪资历史被禁止时，企业无法根据求职者的过往薪资定制工资报价，因此向每组工人提供相同的工资。虽然这有利于相对低收入者，但群体间的工资差距可能会扩大。薪资历史禁令还会影响（年轻）工人在初始谈判中的行为，使其表现得不那么激进，要求的工资也更低。最后，研究表明薪资历史禁令会降低工人流动率，但会增加年轻工人的雇佣。
title: The effects of salary history bans on wages, hiring, and wage gaps
title_zh: 薪资历史禁令对工资、招聘及工资差距的影响

abstract: This study examines the role of oral traditions in shaping corruption. Using firm-level data on a large sample of 82,922 firms covering 287 cultural societies in 125 countries, we analyze how the representation of antisocial behavior in folklore is associated with corruption. Our findings reveal that societies with folklore portraying antisocial behaviors as successful tend to exhibit higher levels of corruption, while those with oral traditions emphasizing the negative outcomes of such behaviors experience lower corruption. By distinguishing demand- and supply-side corruption channels, we document that folklore is associated with variations in bribe-related decisions, both for firms that are initiators and targets. Thus, our work contributes to the understanding of deep-rooted cultural determinants of corruption.
title: The trickster’s legacy: The folklore roots of corruption
title_zh: 骗子的遗产：腐败的民俗根源

abstract: This paper studies a concentrated Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) estimation method that offers significant computational advantages while delivering valid inference for parameters of interest. By reducing the dimension of parameters to be sampled, this method substantially decreases computational time and memory usage relative to both traditional and some state-of-the-art Bayesian algorithms. Its applicability extends to correctly specified or misspecified likelihood functions, as well as generalized method of moments objective functions. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the biases and root mean squared errors of the concentrated MCMC estimators are typically smaller than or comparable to those of conventional Bayesian estimators. Furthermore, this method exhibits reliable model selection performance. We establish the large sample properties of the concentrated MCMC estimator. An empirical application analyzing the network spillover effect of stock returns in the Chinese A-share market further illustrates the advantages of this method.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种集中马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）估计方法，该方法在提供有效推断的同时，具有显著的计算优势。通过降低待采样参数的维度，与传统及部分前沿贝叶斯算法相比，该方法大幅减少了计算时间和内存使用。其适用性涵盖正确设定或错误设定的似然函数，以及广义矩方法目标函数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，集中MCMC估计器的偏差和均方根误差通常小于或相当于传统贝叶斯估计器。此外，该方法展现出可靠的模型选择性能。我们确立了集中MCMC估计器的大样本性质。一项针对中国A股市场股票收益网络溢出效应的实证应用进一步展示了该方法的优势。

abstract: This paper revisits the empirical analysis of Nakamura and Steinsson (2014). I reconstructed and extended the original dataset to cover the period 1966–2019, harmonizing two major sources of data: the Defense Contract Action Data System (DCADS) and USAspending.gov. I discuss how to aggregate these contract‐level data to better capture spending more directly tied to domestic stimulus. Estimated multipliers are slightly lower in narrow replications but increase when incorporating later fiscal episodes. I also assess the validity and stability of cross‐sectional estimates. While some heterogeneity exists, dispersion in state‐level responses remains within reasonable boundaries, especially when accounting for dynamic persistence.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nakamura与Steinsson（2014）的实证分析。我重构并扩展了原始数据集，将研究时段覆盖至1966-2019年，整合了两大主要数据来源：国防合同行动数据系统（DCADS）与USAspending.gov。我探讨了如何聚合这些合同级数据，以更精准地捕捉与国内刺激直接相关的支出。在狭义复制中，估计乘数略低，但纳入后期财政事件后有所上升。我还评估了横截面估计的有效性与稳定性。尽管存在一定异质性，但各州层面响应的离散程度仍处于合理范围内，尤其是在考虑动态持续性之后。
title: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
title_zh: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自1966-2019年美国国防采购的证据

abstract: Food waste from restaurants contributes to greenhouse gas emissions and puts pressure on urban waste systems, especially in low and middle-income countries. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to assess whether food waste management training reduces kitchen-level organic waste in micro-sized and small restaurants in the hospitality industry in Cusco, Peru, a major global tourist destination. We find that the intervention reduces food waste generation by 10 percent in the trained restaurants. We also find that it improved the staff’s knowledge and awareness of food waste management practices. A simple cost-benefit analysis suggests that skills-building interventions can improve the pro-environmental performance of micro and small firms and can be implemented with a positive net benefit to society.
abstract_zh: 餐厅产生的食物浪费加剧了温室气体排放，并对城市废弃物系统造成压力，尤其是在中低收入国家。我们在秘鲁库斯科——一个全球重要的旅游目的地——开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估食物浪费管理培训是否能减少酒店业中微型和小型餐厅的厨房有机废弃物。我们发现，该干预措施使受训餐厅的食物浪费产生量减少了10%。同时，干预还提升了员工对食物浪费管理实践的知识和意识。一项简单的成本效益分析表明，技能建设干预能够改善微型和小型企业的环境友好表现，并可为社会带来正净效益。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Trained to reduce food waste: Evidence from an RCT with micro-sized and small enterprises in Cusco's hospitality industry
title_zh: 减少食物浪费培训：库斯科酒店业微型和小型企业随机对照试验的证据

abstract: The discourse on human trafficking often depicts migrants as deceived victims, while alternative accounts view trafficking as a constrained migration strategy. We contribute to this debate using original survey data from two cross-sectional waves (2021 and 2023) covering more than 2700 respondents in Edo State, Nigeria. A substantial share of respondents reports a willingness to migrate via traffickers despite awareness of the risks of forced labor. A list experiment provides suggestive evidence of underreporting of trafficking approval, particularly among women, likely reflecting stigma surrounding sex work. We examine the determinants of trafficking approval through an aspirations–capabilities framework. Willingness to migrate via traffickers is highest among individuals with strong migration aspirations but limited capabilities. In contrast, exposure to anti-trafficking campaigns has little effect. Respondents are generally well-informed about the potential risks and returns associated with trafficking and do not exhibit cognitive biases such as motivated reasoning. Overall, our findings suggest that trafficking is not primarily driven by ignorance, but instead reflects a constrained choice shaped by limited legal migration options and structural barriers. • 1 in 4 would consider trafficking for migration despite forced labor risks in a representative survey in Edo State, Nigeria. • List experiment reveals gendered underreporting. • High aspirations and low capabilities predict trafficking approval. • Prospective migrants who would resort to trafficking hold reasonable risk and income expectations, with no evidence of motivated reasoning or selective recall. • Awareness campaigns show limited impact; structural reform is needed.
abstract_zh: 关于人口贩运的讨论常将移民描绘为受骗的受害者，而另一些观点则将贩运视为一种受限的迁移策略。我们利用2021年和2023年两轮横截面调查的原始数据，覆盖尼日利亚埃多州超过2700名受访者，为这一辩论提供实证依据。相当比例的受访者表示，尽管知晓强迫劳动的风险，仍愿意通过贩运者进行迁移。一项列表实验提供了暗示性证据，表明对贩运的认可存在低报现象，尤其在女性中更为显著，这可能反映了围绕性工作的污名化。我们通过愿望-能力框架考察贩运认可的决定因素。在具有强烈迁移愿望但能力有限的个体中，通过贩运者迁移的意愿最高。相比之下，反贩运宣传活动的接触影响甚微。受访者普遍对贩运相关的潜在风险和回报有充分了解，并未表现出动机性推理等认知偏差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，贩运并非主要由无知驱动，而是反映了在有限合法迁移选择和结构性障碍下形成的受限选择。• 在尼日利亚埃多州的一项代表性调查中，尽管存在强迫劳动风险，仍有四分之一的人会考虑通过贩运进行迁移。• 列表实验揭示了性别差异性的低报现象。• 高愿望和低能力预测贩运认可。• 可能诉诸贩运的潜在移民对风险和收入持有合理预期，没有动机性推理或选择性记忆的证据。• 宣传活动影响有限；需要进行结构性改革。
title: Trafficking as choice? Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 贩卖作为选择？来自尼日利亚的证据

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic game-theoretic framework to analyze security competition between two states that can invest in a technology to eliminate their rival. Extending the canonical one-shot game, our model incorporates a negotiation (settlement) stage and assumes effective diplomacy, which rules out payoff-dominated equilibria. We fully characterize equilibrium behavior across all discount factors and compare outcomes under high and low elimination costs. The dynamic structure reveals why, even with optimal coordination, long-lasting disarmed peace is rare. By combining the dynamics of military escalation with the constraints of effective diplomacy, the model rationalizes historical cycles of peace, arms races, and conflict. Our approach identifies strategic mechanisms that restrict the sustainability of disarmament and clarifies the conditions under which arms races or conflict become inevitable, offering a deeper understanding of the recurrent nature of international conflict under repeated interaction.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态博弈理论框架，用于分析两个国家在投资消除对手技术时的安全竞争。在经典单次博弈的基础上，我们的模型引入了谈判（和解）阶段，并假设有效外交排除了收益占优均衡。我们全面刻画了所有折现因子下的均衡行为，并比较了高消除成本与低消除成本下的结果。动态结构揭示了为何即使在最优协调下，持久的非武装和平也极为罕见。通过将军事升级的动态过程与有效外交的约束相结合，该模型合理化了和平、军备竞赛与冲突的历史循环。我们的方法识别出限制裁军可持续性的战略机制，并阐明了军备竞赛或冲突不可避免的条件，从而在重复互动背景下为理解国际冲突的反复性提供了更深刻的洞见。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The elusive quest for disarmed peace: contest games and international relations
title_zh: 寻求解除武装和平的艰难探索：竞争博弈与国际关系

abstract: States sometimes back rebellions abroad to signal resolve. We study this reputation-building logic in international relations, focusing on co-ethnic links between countries as an objective source of variation in a state‚s incentives to demonstrate resolve. We formally derive two interconnected predictions from the mechanism: (a) a state is more likely to endorse the uprising of a foreign group when facing a larger audience, resulting in (b) greater political inclusion for the group. We build a comprehensive panel dataset of co-ethnic rebellion sponsorship, and find evidence consistent with both predictions.
abstract_zh: 国家有时会支持国外的叛乱以展示其决心。我们研究国际关系中的这种声誉构建逻辑，重点关注国家间基于同族裔联系这一客观因素，如何影响国家展示决心的动机。我们通过形式化推导得出两个相互关联的预测：（a）当面对更广泛的受众时，国家更可能支持外国群体的起义，从而（b）该群体获得更大的政治包容性。我们构建了关于同族裔叛乱赞助的全面面板数据集，并发现了与这两个预测一致的证据。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Building Reputation: State-Sponsored Rebellions and Transnational Identities,
title_zh: 构建声誉：国家支持的叛乱与跨国身份

abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何影响美国医疗保险体系的发展。通过与政治公关公司Campaigns, Inc.合作，AMA发起了一场全国性运动，将国家医疗保险框架定义为“社会化医疗”以削弱其支持度，同时引导民众加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案转移。基于新整理的档案数据，我们发现，该运动对私人医疗保险参保率上升的贡献约为20%，并对国家医保计划公众支持率的下降产生了同等程度的影响。该运动还通过协调信息传递、民间组织通过的决议、国会言论以及政治捐款，对政策制定产生了影响。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅由宏观经济力量或集体谈判驱动，而是由利益集团资助的战略性努力所推动，旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策。
title: Why Doesn’t the United States Have National Health Insurance? The Political Role of the American Medical Association
title_zh: 美国为何没有全民医保？美国医学会的政治角色

abstract: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了关注气候的天然气生产商面临的一个根本性困境及时间不一致性问题。短期内，增加产量以超越煤炭颇具吸引力。然而，当这一政策被预期到时，可再生能源投资将减少，最终排放量可能上升。当天然气生产商无法预先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。应用于欧洲的模拟版本验证了“天然气陷阱”在数量上的重要性。我们讨论了这一结果的稳健性及可能的解决方案，范围从对可再生能源的直接投资到对天然气勘探与开采征税。
title: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
title_zh: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争

abstract: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析联邦量刑中快克可卡因数量分布的异常聚集现象，研究刑事司法体系中的种族差异。我将2010年《公平量刑法》实施前后判决的案件进行对比——该法案将触发10年强制最低刑期的快克可卡因门槛从50克调整为280克。首先发现，2010年后以280克（当前触发10年强制最低刑期的临界点）量刑的案件比例急剧上升，且黑人及西班牙裔罪犯在此增幅中占比显著偏高。随后探讨了导致观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法体系后发生的种族歧视。通过分析刑事司法体系多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯的聚集现象加剧源于检察官的自由裁量权，具体表现为约20-30%检察官的裁量行为。此外，当2013年证据标准趋严时，280克量刑案件比例出现下降。最后，这种增幅中的种族差异无法通过教育程度、性别、年龄、犯罪前科、毒品查获数量或其他犯罪要素来解释，但可在很大程度上由州级种族敌意指标解释。这些研究结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权与种族歧视作为量刑种族差异成因的作用机制。
title: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
title_zh: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据

abstract: This paper explores whether the transmission from monetary policy to income inequality may depend on the adoption of Inflation Targeting (IT) regimes. Using an interacted panel VAR, we find that expansionary monetary policy shocks reduce income inequality in countries that have switched to IT regimes. In contrast, in non-IT regimes the same shock is associated with a short-lived increase in income inequality. A decomposition of transmission channels indicates that the employment channel is the primary equalizing mechanism under IT, as expansionary shocks generate stronger improvements in labor market conditions. The financial channel operates in the opposite direction but is quantitatively smaller. We further show that the inequality-reducing effects of monetary policy are not replicated by other institutional features often associated with credibility, such as central bank transparency or central bank independence. Our findings are robust to alternative identification schemes, broader classifications of IT regimes, controls for self-selection into IT adoption, and to conditioning on different inflation environments.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策向收入不平等的传导是否可能取决于通胀目标制（IT）制度的采纳。通过使用交互面板VAR模型，我们发现，在已转向通胀目标制的国家，扩张性货币政策冲击会降低收入不平等。相比之下，在非通胀目标制国家，同样的冲击则与收入不平等的短期加剧相关。对传导渠道的分解表明，就业渠道是通胀目标制下的主要均等化机制，因为扩张性冲击能更显著地改善劳动力市场状况。金融渠道则朝相反方向作用，但其影响在数量上较小。我们进一步证明，货币政策的降低不平等效应并不能被其他常与可信度相关的制度特征所复制，如中央银行透明度或中央银行独立性。我们的研究结果对于替代识别方案、更广泛的通胀目标制分类、对采纳通胀目标制的自选择控制以及不同通胀环境下的条件设定均保持稳健。
title: Inflation targeting, Monetary policy, and Inequality
title_zh: 通胀目标、货币政策与不平等

abstract: We study a persuasion problem in which the receiver has the ability to probabilistically verify the state at a cost. The sender wants to convince the receiver to accept a project, but the receiver is only willing to accept the project when its quality is above a threshold. The optimal disclosure policy strikes a balance between influencing the receiver’s decisions to accept and to verify the quality. It is deterministic and involves at most three messages, each consisting of an acceptance recommendation and a verification recommendation. Under the optimal disclosure policy, the acceptance recommendation exhibits a cutoff structure, while the verification recommendation exhibits a negative assortative structure. Specifically, the optimal disclosure policy recommends acceptance when the quality exceeds a certain threshold. When the quality falls below this threshold, rejection without verification is recommended. For qualities above the threshold, verification is not recommended if the quality lies within the middle range of the interval. Using the characterization of the optimal disclosure policy, we conduct comparative statics and show that verification is recommended when the probability of successful verification is moderate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个说服问题，其中接收方有能力以一定成本对状态进行概率性验证。发送方希望说服接收方接受一个项目，但接收方仅在项目质量高于某一阈值时才愿意接受。最优披露策略在影响接收方接受决策与验证质量决策之间取得平衡。该策略是确定性的，并涉及至多三条信息，每条信息包含一个接受建议和一个验证建议。在最优披露策略下，接受建议呈现截断结构，而验证建议呈现负匹配结构。具体而言，最优披露策略在质量超过某一阈值时建议接受。当质量低于此阈值时，建议不验证即拒绝。对于高于阈值的质量，若质量位于区间中间范围，则不建议验证。利用最优披露策略的特征化，我们进行了比较静态分析，并表明当验证成功的概率适中时，会建议进行验证。
title: Information design with endogenous state verification
title_zh: 内生状态验证下的信息设计
